context: Tests whether the agent applies this plugin's frontmatter convention for an always-on rule: alwaysApply: true in the rule file frontmatter with no scoping fields (applyTo, globs, paths), and the rule registered as a path in the plugin.json rules array. In the plugin manifest form, per-rule scope lives only in the rule file frontmatter — .tessl-plugin/plugin.json carries no steering map or per-rule alwaysApply. Baseline agents without the plugin typically write rules with no frontmatter beyond a single alwaysApply: true, invent unnecessary scoping fields, or model the manifest after the legacy tile.json steering map. This plugin prescribes that an always-on rule omits scope, declares alwaysApply: true in frontmatter, and is listed as a path in the rules array.

checklist.name: Rule file frontmatter declares alwaysApply: true
checklist.description: The rules/spaces-not-tabs.md file has a YAML frontmatter block at the top with alwaysApply: true. Scores zero if frontmatter is missing entirely, if alwaysApply is false, or if alwaysApply is omitted from the block

checklist.name: Rule file frontmatter declares no scoping fields
checklist.description: The rules/spaces-not-tabs.md frontmatter does NOT contain applyTo, globs, or paths fields. The rule applies universally; including any of those fields signals a scoped intent that contradicts the rule's universal nature. Baseline agents may invent scoping fields spuriously; the plugin prescribes omitting them for universal rules

checklist.name: plugin.json rules array includes the new rule path
checklist.description: The updated .tessl-plugin/plugin.json rules array includes the path rules/spaces-not-tabs.md. Scores zero if the path is missing or wrong, or if the agent adds a steering map or a per-rule alwaysApply field to the manifest — that is the legacy tile.json model; plugin.json lists rule paths only and carries no per-rule config

checklist.name: Rule body has H1 title matching the filename concept
checklist.description: The rule body starts with an H1 heading like # Spaces Not Tabs (or close equivalent) that matches the filename. Scores zero if there is no H1 or the H1 is unrelated to the file's concept

checklist.name: Rule body has at least one substantive bullet
checklist.description: The rule body contains at least one actionable bullet stating the prescription (e.g., 'Use spaces for indentation, not tabs'). Scores zero if the body is empty, contains only the H1, or fills the body with non-prescriptive prose

checklist.name: Existing rules and manifest entries are preserved unchanged
checklist.description: The two pre-existing rule paths (rules/manifest-pin.md, rules/test-fixture-hygiene.md) remain in the plugin.json rules array, and the inputs/rules/manifest-pin.md and inputs/rules/test-fixture-hygiene.md files are not modified. Scores zero if any pre-existing path is dropped or a pre-existing rule file is altered
